title: Fig and the Round Thing
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: There is no right or wrong answer to what the round thing is — enjoy guessing together and talking about how Fig works it out using his senses.

pages.talk_prompt: Fig has spotted something round and shiny below — what do you think it could be?
pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar on a leaf, looking down at something small, round and silver glinting on the ground below in the hedge.

pages.talk_prompt: Fig has climbed all the way down to look closer — what do you notice about the shiny thing?
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar close beside a small round silver button lying among fallen leaves at the base of the hedge.

pages.talk_prompt: Fig is trying to roll the round thing — what do you think will happen?
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar nudging the small silver button with his head, the button rolling a little across the leaves.

pages.talk_prompt: Fig is sniffing the round thing carefully — does it seem to be food?
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar leaning in close, sniffing the silver button, looking puzzled.

pages.talk_prompt: Fig has decided where to keep the round thing safe — where has he tucked it?
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar tucking the small silver button safely under a big green leaf in the hedge.

pages.talk_prompt: Fig still does not know what the round thing is, but how does he feel about it?
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar patting the green leaf over his hidden treasure, looking pleased with himself.
